_comment: Hand written subjects for zones the automatic builder cannot describe. Each of these failed review because the zone's own standard names a rule or a place rather than a thing: 'floor and circulation path', 'paper and household backstock', 'surface rail and safety zone'. There is nothing in those sentences for a model to draw, so it renders the room and ignores the zone. These name the objects instead. Keep them concrete and countable, and keep them under about twenty words, because the encoder truncates at 77 tokens and the subject must survive.
entryway--door-mat-and-immediate-floor: a coir door mat on bare wood floor just inside a closed front door, nothing else on the floor
entryway--landing-zone: a shallow wooden tray on a console table holding keys, sunglasses and a wallet, bare wood either side
family-room--blanket-and-comfort-zone: a woven basket holding four folded throw blankets beside a sofa
family-room--board-game-and-puzzle-zone: board game boxes and jigsaw puzzles stacked flat on a low shelf
family-room--charging-and-device-zone: a small charging tray with two phone cables coiled beside a power strip on a side table
family-room--primary-media-zone: a wall mounted television above a low media console, remote controls in a small tray
garage--hand-tool-wall-and-cabinets: a pegboard wall of hand tools, hammers, pliers and screwdrivers hung in rows above a cabinet
guest-bathroom--guest-linen-zone: folded white bath towels stacked in threes on an open shelf with a hand towel and a face cloth
guest-bedroom--guest-dresser: a wooden chest of drawers with two drawers open showing folded clothes, a lamp on top
guest-bedroom--guest-nightstand: a bedside table with a lamp, a coaster, one book and a small dish, beside a made bed
hall-closet--cleaning-equipment-zone: an upright vacuum cleaner, a broom and a mop standing together inside an open closet
hall-closet--cleaning-supply-zone: labelled spray bottles and cloths in a plastic caddy on a closet shelf
hall-closet--linen-shelf-zone: folded bed sheets and pillowcases stacked in labelled piles on closet shelves
hall-closet--paper-and-household-backsto: packs of paper towels and toilet rolls stacked on an upper closet shelf
home-office--file-storage: an open filing drawer of labelled hanging folders beside a desk
home-office--printer-and-scanning-statio: a desktop printer on a low cabinet with a neat stack of paper beside it
kids-bedroom--bed-and-sleep-zone: a child's bed made flat with one pillow squared and a folded quilt at the foot
kitchen--upper-cabinet-zone: an open upper kitchen cabinet with plates stacked and glasses in rows
laundry-room--detergent-and-treatment-zo: one detergent bottle, one stain remover and a measuring cup on a shelf above a washing machine
laundry-room--folding-surface: a clear counter above a washer and dryer with one stack of folded towels
laundry-room--sorting-and-hamper-zone: three labelled laundry hampers side by side against a wall
mudroom--pet-station: a dog lead on a hook above two pet bowls on a mat, a bin of pet food beside them
nursery--diaper-and-care-backstock: packs of nappies and wipes stacked in a labelled basket on a low shelf
nursery--feeding-station: a nursing chair with a small side table holding a bottle, a cloth and a lamp
pantry--baking-zone: labelled jars of flour and sugar with mixing bowls and a rolling pin on a pantry shelf
patio-or-deck--surface-rail-and-safety-z: a swept wooden deck with a clean handrail and clear steps, a coiled hose on a hook
primary-bathroom--under-sink-cabinet: an open bathroom vanity cabinet with two labelled bins and spare rolls under the pipe
primary-bedroom--dresser-drawers: a bedroom chest of drawers with one drawer open showing folded clothes in rows
workshop--fastener-and-hardware-zone: small parts drawers and clear jars of screws and bolts labelled on a shelf
workshop--finishing-and-chemical-zone: tins of paint and varnish standing upright on a shelf in a ventilated cabinet
workshop--material-rack: a rack of timber boards and sheet stock stored upright against a workshop wall
workshop--safety-and-ppe-station: safety glasses, ear defenders and a dust mask hanging on hooks beside a first aid box
